design: Twelve prospective synthetic natural-language scenarios in fixed order: eight fully specified supported cases over diverse existing optical families, four negative controls.
sampling: Fixed authored prospective synthetic scenarios, not random or representative; no textbook question images or Solutions.
firstAttempt: Same ChatGPT assistant writes exactly one opticsim-problem-v1 envelope per prompt, after prompts commit and before any deterministic validation/scoring. No independent model API and no repairs.
evaluation: Use frozen reference for factual/component fidelity and requested quantities, deterministic preflight, then existing native workflow. Score each dimension separately; do not count fixture/native success as LLM benchmark.
controls: No experimental provider transfer, no synthetic brightness/aperture/angle guessing, never substitute geometry or rewrite originals.
